verdict.line: You lose if you throw autos or Q into an up Riposte and let her stack vitals procs in extended trades; you win if you bait her W down with E poke, then all-in with Q-E-R while it's on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Fiora's entire kit is a bet that she gets to pick the trade: W (Riposte) punishes any single-target attack or ability you commit, turning your engage into her stun and a free vital reveal. The matchup is decided by whether you feed her free parries or force damage she physically cannot block — E (Judgment)'s AoE ticks and R (Demacian Justice)'s execute — instead.

theirWindow.when: Levels 3-5, Riposte up and E charged
theirWindow.what: She'll pop E (Bladework) for two empowered autos, lunge in with Q (Lunge), and hold W to punish whatever you throw back. Don't commit Q (Decisive Strike) or auto into her here — poke with E's AoE tick instead, which Riposte can't block, and only trade autos after she's already used W.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Riposte) is on cooldown or already used
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window: Q (Decisive Strike) for the silence and guaranteed stick, E (Judgment) to shred her armor and stack damage, and from level 6 on, threaten R (Demacian Justice) the moment she's under roughly 30% HP.

powerCurve.note: Trades are even if you don't overextend into her poke
Riposte plus empowered autos punish careless engages
Your R execute threat offsets her ult's duel sustain
Her duelist item spike starts outscaling your bruiser core
Sterak's/Sundered Sky and R burst keep you relevant

start.why: The extra sustain and on-hit damage help you win the even short trades in the level 1-2 poke phase before either ultimate or item power comes online.

boots.why: A large share of Fiora's early-to-mid damage is basic-attack based (autos plus on-hit vital procs), and flat attack damage reduction cuts that harder than any other boots option.

core.why: The slow on the active lets you actually stick a silenced target instead of watching her Q (Lunge) reset away after a trade.
Its healing and isolated-target crit chance are built for exactly this kind of 1v1 lane, and it rewards landing E first before she can parry anything.
The health and tenacity-adjacent survivability keep you alive through her true-damage vital procs once she's a full build ahead of just AD stacking.

situational.when: you keep getting parried and stunned or her team adds extra CC to lock you down
she snowballs early and starts running away with kills off crit/on-hit items
her team stacks magic damage alongside her so you need the resistance shred and cleanse
you're diving her backline in teamfights and need a second commitment

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing conversion reward the exact extended-duel style this matchup forces, and it keeps scaling through the mid-game window where Fiora otherwise pulls ahead.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you scale into your item spikes and reset after losing early trades instead of being stuck in a lane you're behind in; Flash is mandatory to dodge her Q (Lunge) engage or to land a point-blank R.

playing.title: Never Q into an up Riposte
playing.detail: If she parries your Q (Decisive Strike), she gets a free stun on you plus a vital reveal for basically no cost. Bait the W with something else first.

playing.title: Poke with E, not autos
playing.detail: Judgment's AoE tick is untargeted and can't be blocked by Riposte, so use it to whittle her down and force vital procs without risking the parry punish.

playing.title: Track her vital timer
playing.detail: Every damaging hit she lands opens a vital window on you for a few seconds — if she's chasing it, your trade is worse than it looks, so disengage instead of auto-trading through it.

playing.title: All-in the moment W is down
playing.detail: Once you've seen or baited Riposte, commit fully with Q-E-R; her only remaining out is Q (Lunge), which has a real cooldown you can count.

playing.title: Respect the execute threshold from level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice scales off missing health, so any stray moment she's under roughly 30% is a kill threat she has to play around.

playing.title: Watch for her E before she engages
playing.detail: Bladework gives her two empowered attacks; if she pops it before closing distance she's committing to a trade window right now — punish it with E or disengage entirely.

playing.title: Group before objectives once she's ahead
playing.detail: A fed Fiora with her ult up flanks with bonus movement speed and can delete an isolated target with true-damage vitals, so don't let her pick you off alone.

brief.patchCaveat: Core mechanics here (Riposte blocking single-target attacks/abilities but not Judgment's AoE, vitals granting true damage, R scaling off missing health) have been stable across recent seasons, but exact cooldowns, item actives, and rune names drift patch to patch — verify Riposte's cooldown curve and your item spike timing against the live patch before locking in.
